text:
alex: Heads-up: repro for the perf regression on dedicated cards. I built a small synth generator called 'batchpicker' to stress kernel selection + KV warmup. TL;DR shows tail latency increase when batchpicker hits microbursts with cold KV.

morgan: Nice. Can you share config? I'm curious about ramp profile.

alex: pasted config:
```json
{"qps_profile":"sawtooth", "base_qps":20, "burst_qps":800, "burst_dur_ms":200, "burst_interval_s":45, "seq_len_dist":"long_tail_95_512"}
```

claudia: how are you seeding KV? cold vs warm matters a lot.

alex: three modes: cold (no prefix cache), warm-kv (preload 30% samples), sticky (per-worker persistent KV). Observed CPU kernel fallback to generic matmul in cold mode.

kevin: logs?

alex: paste perf snippet:
```
[2026-03-05T15:02:23Z] svc0 worker2 batchpicker: batch_size=1 qps=720 p99=312ms kernel=generic_matmul
[2026-03-05T15:02:23Z] svc0 worker2 batchpicker: batch_size=8 qps=720 p99=78ms kernel=small_seq_opt
```

sasha: so small batches fall into specialized kernels, singletons hit generic path -> big tail

priya: could be our heuristic picks kernel by avg_seq_len per-batch. Microbursts with high variance cause wrong pick

morgan: can you rerun with 'batch_picker_v2' that uses per-request seq_len histogram weighting? I pushed a branch.

alex: running now. quick diff shows ~2.1x tail improvement in warm mode, still 1.5x in cold. results:
- cold p99 312ms -> 210ms
- warm p99 78ms -> 35ms

claudia: nice. Did you adjust KV warmup timing? maybe aggressive prefetch helps.

alex: tried prefetch 5s before burst; reduced cold p99 to 160ms but added extra CPU cost. tradeoff graph attached (not shown)

kevin: for apples-to-apples, we should fix GPU binning and quantization across runs. Did you pin kernels and quant flags?

alex: yes pinned model variant v2q and disabled auto-quant fallback. also ensured same CUDA kernels via env VAR KERNEL_SET=stable

sasha: next steps: 1) add stochastic burst seeds to loadgen, 2) instrument per-batch seq_len variance in console, 3) propose batching thermostat tweak to delay kernel switch until batch size >=3 or variance low.

alex: filing PR with results + small reproducer script. cc @morgan @priya for review. (reaction :eyes:)

morgan: ack. also open a perf regression incident if this correlates with the production spike on 2026-03-04.

alex: will do. thanks all.
